fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami city commission actions and local governance, including criticism of out-of-town contracting and a band contract; coverage of a grand jury investigation connected to police matters and broader county affairs; political notes and local civic topics such as proposed sites for a new Miami post office and discussion of the Dade County Fair. Also contains local business commentary (including the ice industry), community columns, entertainment and nightlife listings/advertisements, and multiple paid political advertisements for local offices.
